<thought>To identify the template that, when applied to the target molecule (the alkene product), yields the listed precursors, I will search the template catalog using criteria that reflect the Still‑Gennari reaction: breaking an alkene (C=C) and forming an aldehyde carbonyl and a phosphonate ester. I will use the first SMILES from the precursor list as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde", "phosphonate"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
